description: This Java class, RenderableFtlSequence, is part of the org.apache.ofbiz.widget.renderer.macro.renderable package. It is designed to compose multiple RenderableFtl objects into a sequence, allowing them to be processed together via the accept method that utilizes a visitor pattern. The class includes a nested builder class for constructing instances fluently.

classes.name: RenderableFtlSequence
classes.description: A class that aggregates multiple RenderableFtl instances and applies visitor operations to each.

classes.name: RenderableFtlSequenceBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing RenderableFtlSequence instances with a fluent API.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor that performs operations on each RenderableFtl in the sequence.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for creating RenderableFtlSequence objects.

methods.name: renderableFtl
methods.description: Adds a RenderableFtl object to the sequence via the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the RenderableFtlSequence with the accumulated RenderableFtl objects.
